localFacts.fact: The Alhambra (Patronato de la Alhambra y Generalife) only allows photos without flash and without a tripod, monopod or any other camera stabiliser.
Parque Nacional del Teide: professional photography, filming, video and advertising activities inside the park need an authorisation.

Iberia Express allows a cabin bag of up to 10 kg and max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm including handle, pockets and wheels. The Peak Design (39,4 cm) and the Befree Advanced (40 cm) fold well under 56 cm; the MT190XPRO3 (59 cm) and the Vanguard (about 72 cm) do not.
Vanguard Spain lists the earlier Alta Pro 2 263AB 100 kit as discontinued; the Gen 2 in this post was found on Vanguard US pages.

localPainPoints.pain: Monument visits where tripods are banned.
localPainPoints.fix: Check the venue rules before you pack the tripod; the Alhambra bans tripods and monopods, so plan long exposures from outside the monument.

quotes.text: Leyendo las normas veo que está prohibido el uso de tripode y flash

localPainPoints.pain: A flimsy tripod ruins long exposures.
localPainPoints.fix: Pick thicker 3-section legs (Alta Pro, MT190XPRO3) or the column-free Feisol and keep the column down.
